summary: DIRECTER proposes a practically motivated inference-time fix for oversteering by coupling KV-cache key scaling with a plausibility gate and a one-shot attention-sensitivity layer ranking. The empirical story is coherent and comparatively strong for this sub-area: gains on IFEval/LIFBench/GSM8K-Format, cross-model transfer, ablations of ranking and fixed strength, and a useful demonstration that the gate helps PASTA/SpotLight. The work is closer to a solid systems/methods contribution than a conceptual breakthrough, and main-table significance is under-supported without multi-seed variance, while the rewritten IFEval protocol and LLM-as-judge quality metrics leave residual evaluation risk.
strengths: Clear problem framing (static steering → oversteering) with a concrete adaptive control loop that is easy for practitioners to reason about.
Experiments are organized around explicit RQs and include cross-family/scale transfer, fixed-vs-adaptive strength, ranking/token ablations, efficiency, and quality/fidelity checks.
Shows the plausibility filter as a modular safety gate that improves other steering methods, supporting a broader claim beyond one recipe.
Hyperparameter robustness (especially α) and an honest limitations discussion (metric theory, entangled task/instruction spans) improve credibility.

key_concerns.issue: Main results (Tables 1–2, 4) appear to be single-run greedy evaluations without seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests, despite reporting small gains on some models (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B) and a headline +6.5% average.
key_concerns.suggested_fix: Re-run primary benchmarks with ≥3 seeds (or bootstrap over prompts), report mean±std, and add paired significance tests vs strongest tuned baselines.

key_concerns.issue: IFEval prompts are rewritten via gpt-4o-mini to separate task/instruction spans, altering the standard benchmark; quality/fidelity is also judged by the same model family, creating protocol and judge-bias risk.
key_concerns.suggested_fix: Report original IFEval (or a documented span-detection setting) side-by-side; diversify automatic judges and strengthen/expand human evaluation for Table 4 claims.

key_concerns.issue: Novelty is largely compositional (KV scaling + Contrastive/DoLa-style plausibility filtering + sensitivity ranking); baseline coverage beyond PASTA/SpotLight and prompting is narrow for a generality claim about instruction-following interventions.
key_concerns.suggested_fix: Sharpen contribution claims around the adaptive layer-reduction controller, and add 1–2 stronger recent inference-time / steering / constrained-decoding baselines under matched compute.

key_concerns.issue: GSM8K-Format is author-constructed and central to the no-trade-off narrative; without broader public validation, cherry-picking concern remains.
key_concerns.suggested_fix: Release construction details/splits fully and validate the fidelity claim on at least one additional public format-constrained reasoning set.

questions_for_authors: Are Table 1/2 numbers single greedy runs? If so, what is the prompt-level variance of DIRECTER vs SpotLight★/PASTA★?
How much of the IFEval gain remains on the unmodified original prompts without GPT rewriting?
What fraction of tokens actually invoke steering vs the top-2 skip gate across benchmarks, and how does that correlate with the reported ~16% throughput drop?
Why modulate |L| rather than α for fine-grained control in the main method, given α robustness in Fig. 3b—does Appendix C fully rule out α schedules?
For Table 4, were judges blind to method identity, and do human ratings agree with gpt-4o-mini at the item level?
calibration_check: Core claims of improved instruction following with reduced oversteering are mostly aligned with the reported tables/ablations, but average-percentage and generality language slightly outrun the single-run, rewritten-benchmark, and LLM-judge evidence.

significance.justification: Useful for the instruction-steering community and potentially adoptable as an inference module, but unlikely to redefine the broader ICLR agenda beyond controllable generation.

novelty.justification: Adaptive rejection of steered tokens via layer pruning is a meaningful twist, yet the building blocks (KV scaling, plausibility decoding, sensitivity ranking) are largely known combinations.

rigor.justification: Method and ablations generally support the mechanism story, but rewritten IFEval, self-made GSM8K-Format, and judge-based fidelity weaken the claim–evidence link.

statistical_soundness.justification: Almost no seed/error-bar reporting on primary tables; only random ablations show ±, which is below the bar for trusting small-to-moderate accuracy deltas.

calibration_honesty.justification: Limitations are stated openly and oversteering trade-offs are confronted; some absolute phrasing (up to 6.5%, general mechanism) is a bit strong relative to protocol caveats.

clarity.justification: Problem, algorithm sketch, and RQs are readable and well sequenced; a few notation/algorithm gaps in the extracted text reduce precision but the idea remains followable.

structure_compliance.justification: Standard ICLR flow (intro/related/method/experiments/conclusion) with clear RQs and a scoped limitations paragraph; length appears within a normal conference footprint.

reproducibility.justification: Models, greedy decoding, fixed α/β, ranking equations, and Algorithm 1 give a workable recipe; missing seeds and some appendix-only details remain, ignoring redacted links.

related_work.justification: Positions fairly against instruction tuning, PASTA, and SpotLight and motivates oversteering; comparison set is current enough but not exhaustive for inference-time control.

figure_quality.justification: Captions describe decision-loop overview, adaptive vs fixed strength, robustness sweeps, efficiency, and qualitative examples that directly support the claims rather than decorate.

breadth_generality.justification: Multiple benchmarks, 1B–14B models, and solid ablations support moderate generality; steering-baseline diversity and unmodified real-world prompt entanglement are thinner.

overall_recommendation.justification: Borderline accept: practically valuable and empirically multi-faceted, but needs stronger statistical reporting and cleaner evaluation protocols to clear a confident ICLR accept.
